title: analytics: the dataset draft preview drops a bucketed timeDimensions entry that is not also in dimensions, so it answers one total instead of the time groups
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28555 dev (PR #28686, os-dev-report `6558864662` on #28555), class a, measured. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade yet: a server seat grades it.

Reach: `queryDataset` with `previewDrafts: true`, measured on real SQLite at `0b6a52e8`. `timeDimensions: [{ dimension: 'closed_at', granularity: 'month' }]` on a plain base field: native and ObjectQL group by month (2026-03 → 100, 2026-04 → 80); the preview answers one row, total 180. Only when the same member is also listed in `dimensions` does the preview bucket it.

Business reason: an author previewing a draft dataset's time chart sees one bar where the published dataset shows one per month.

## Wanted

The preview groups a `timeDimensions` entry by its granularity whether or not the member is also in `dimensions`, answering the live strategies' groups.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for `preview timeDimensions granularity`, `preview time dimension not grouped` and `previewDrafts timeDimensions`: only #28555 (this family, the relationship-path face). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`, the draft-preview path, `preview-evaluator.ts`).

Links back: #28555, #28556, PR #28686
